bio: I like building things and asking too many questions. Most of my work sits somewhere between AI, data, and problem-solving. I currently work as a GenAI Engineer, where I develop enterprise AI solutions, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and conversational systems.
But technology has only ever been one part of what I enjoy. I have published a book and multiple research papers. I majored in Electronics Engineering with a minor in Computer Science.

Eventually, I moved from experimenting with ideas to turning them into something tangible. If I had to sum myself up, I’d say I’m naturally curious, happiest when I’m creating something, and someone who enjoys sharing ideas, having meaningful conversations, and connecting with people.
